original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克赞巴拉地区交通事故死亡人数升至24人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克南部赞巴拉地区18日晚发生一起交通事故，造成至少24人死亡、2人受伤，其中1人伤势严重。伊尼扬巴内省政府表示，事故发生在1号国道上，涉及一辆客运车辆与一辆对向行驶的卡车。据初步报道，死者均为客运车辆乘客，事故具体原因尚未确定，警方尚未正式置评。

location.raw_text: Zavala district, southern Mozambique, National Highway Number 1 (N1)

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克赞巴拉地区交通事故造成至少24人死亡、2人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 24 people were killed and two others injured, one of them seriously, in a road accident on Thursday night in Zavala district, southern Mozambique

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The accident occurred on National Highway Number 1 (N1). ... the crash involved a passenger transport vehicle [chapa] and a lorry travelling in the opposite direction

key_facts.fact: 据初步报道，死者均为客运车辆乘客
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: These reports also indicated that all those killed were travelling in the passenger vehicle
